text:
Ari: Heads up: noticed ~0.5% surge in soft-429s on canary for r5-gpu when KV hit rate drops below 12% during morning spike. Batch formation seems to greedily coalesce long reqs and burn token budget. Profiler shows kernel-switch spikes. Anyone else seeing this?
Sam: yep, saw it in dogfood too. prefetch_budget looks small. token_budget_target=64 maybe too aggressive for that mix.
Priya: can you paste profiler dump? curious on kernel_switch/sec and avg batch tokens.
Ari: pasted profiler excerpt:

```
kernel_switch_event: 136 @ 08:02:12
avg_batch_tokens: 842
kv_hit_rate: 0.11
batch_slots_used: 92%
prefetch_alloc: 3
```

Also saw series of kernel handoffs around large seq lengths, causing micro-pauses.
Nina: that avg_batch_tokens is high — batcher is prioritizing throughput. We should bias for token-safety when kv_hit_rate < 0.15.
Michael: propose small config tweak to test: raise token_budget_target and nudge prefetch. Quick patch:

```yaml
admit:
  token_budget_target: 128
  prefetch_budget_per_lane: 6
  soft_429_ratio: 0.015
  prob_reject_long_seq: 0.03
batcher:
  max_latency_ms: 30
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  prioritize_kv_safe: true
```

Sam: I like starting at 128. We should also gate dynamic behavior: token_budget_target scales with kv_hit_rate.
Priya: simple rule: token_budget_target = clamp(64, 256, int(128 * (kv_hit_rate / 0.2))) — that'll increase budget when hits are high, keep low when misses.
Ari: agree. Also add metric targets for the canary: kernel_switch_count, avg_batch_tokens, soft_429_rate, p99_latency. Roll for 1h.
ops-bot: Deploy: admit-config v2 applied to canary at 4812350001 by @ops-bot :white_check_mark:
Nina: monitoring now. if kernel_switch_count stays down and soft_429_rate drops, we can roll to 10%.
Michael: also add a fallback to probabilistic reject when seq_len > 1024 to avoid huge batch tail.
Priya: noted. I'll add the canary dashboard panel and alert if soft_429 > 0.4% for 3m.
Ari: action items: (1) Priya add dashboard + alert, (2) Nina run canary with token_budget_target=128 then dynamic rule after 30m, (3) Sam validate perfprof outputs. We'll reconvene in 45m. :thumbsup:
